proposal.thesis: CrowdStrike is a name I found by scanning past this run's top-ranked (but extended/binary-heavy) setups: it isn't in this run's ~30-name deep-research focus set, so this uses the compact scan row plus WebSearch rather than the full fundamentals/options bundle. CRWD sits 17.5% off its 52-week high after a ~6% single-day pullback attributed to profit-taking on a stretched valuation post its July 2 4-for-1 split, not to any fundamental deterioration -- Q1 FY2027 revenue was $1.39B (+26% YoY) with record 32% net-new ARR growth and FY guidance raised by more than $50M. The stock is below its 50-DMA but still above its 200-DMA and in a weekly uptrend (RSI 44.5, pulled back from overbought into the classic 40-50 reset zone), and today's volume read is no_supply_pullback -- the single volume signature that survived this system's own 12-year ablation study (+0.22 to +0.25pp ATR-matched at both 21d and 63d) -- consistent with light-volume, non-distributive selling. Wall Street stayed bullish through the drop: UBS, Benchmark and Needham all reiterated Buy with split-adjusted targets of $230-235 (26-28% above today's WebSearch-verified ~$183 price, since the bundle's live overlay is stale), even as Morgan Stanley trimmed to a more cautious $172. Next earnings (Q2 FY2027) land Sep 2, 2026, outside this ~28-day holding window, so this is a trade around the print, on the technical reclaim, not through the binary. It also diversifies the book away from BKR's energy driver and away from this run's flagged AI-momentum-unwind leaders (DDOG/SNOW/DELL) into a distinct cybersecurity demand driver.

proposal.risk_map: The clearest ways this fails: (1) the cybersecurity sector rotation is genuinely decelerating (1m sector momentum fell 19.7pp in three weeks per sector_rotation_30d) -- if that broadens into a real growth-software de-rating rather than a pause, CRWD's high multiple has real room to compress further regardless of its own fundamentals; (2) Microsoft's continued Defender/Sentinel bundling is a structural competitive overhang that could show up in a future ARR miss; (3) the no_supply_pullback read is a single scan-day snapshot, not a confirmed reversal -- if volume expands to the downside on the next decline, the accumulation read is wrong; (4) this is a non-focus scan name, so I do not have this run's deep fundamentals, options-implied move, or filings excerpts -- sizing and the stop rely on ATR and WebSearch-sourced analyst targets rather than the full bundle. Early tell: a close below $165 on rising volume, or the cybersecurity sector_rotation_30d trend decelerating further.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Wall Street remains structurally bullish on CrowdStrike after the Q1 FY2027 beat (revenue $1.39B, +26% YoY, record 32% net-new ARR growth, raised FY guidance by $50M+), with UBS, Benchmark and Needham reiterating Buy ratings and split-adjusted targets of $230-235 versus today's ~$183 price -- roughly 26-28% implied upside -- even after the stock's post-split pullback. MY VIEW: the market is currently pricing last Friday's ~6% single-day drop and this month's broader cybersecurity-sector deceleration (sector 1-month momentum fell from +21.2% to +1.5% in our own scan, a -19.7pp swing) as company-specific deterioration in CRWD, when the volume signature says otherwise -- this run's own scan flags CRWD's pullback as no_supply_pullback, the one volume read in this system's 12-year study that showed a genuine positive edge, meaning the decline is unwinding on light volume rather than a broken thesis. MECHANISM: sell-side models and momentum-following flows are conflating sector-wide multiple compression (high-growth software broadly de-rating amid this run's flagged AI-momentum-factor unwind) with idiosyncratic weakness at a name whose own fundamentals (guidance raised, ARR accelerating) have not changed -- that gap between price action and fundamentals is the mispricing. RESOLUTION: a reclaim and close back above the ~$190 50-DMA on above-average volume within the next 3-4 weeks (by ~2026-08-27, ahead of the Sep 2 FY2027 Q2 print) is the observable tell that the market is correcting the overreaction; if that reclaim fails and CRWD instead closes below its recent swing low, the mispricing thesis is wrong, not confirmed.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Any 8-K, guidance cut, or confirmed news of a major competitive displacement (e.g., a large enterprise customer publicly switching to Microsoft Defender or SentinelOne), or trailing net-new ARR growth breaking below its ~25% recent pace, before the 2026-09-02 print.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $165 (the planned stop, ~10% below entry) or a break of the July 2026 swing low on above-average (rvol >= 1.5x) volume, confirming distribution rather than the no_supply_pullback read.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If CRWD has not reclaimed and held a daily close above ~$188-190 (its 50-DMA) within 20 trading days of entry (by approximately 2026-08-27, before the Sep 2 FY2027 Q2 earnings print), exit and rotate rather than hold through the binary.
